items.title: Keep the host isolated and flag it for investigation
items.revert: Only an analyst ends the isolation (S4, response spec section 9).

items.title: Isolate the host and block the source IP
items.revert: The simulated IP block ends on its own after 60, 120 or 240 minutes (containment.toml); only an analyst ends the isolation (S4).

items.title: Isolate the host and disable the involved account
items.revert: Only an analyst ends the isolation (S4) and re-enables the account; nothing ends on its own.

items.title: Release isolation and raise monitoring
items.revert: An analyst can isolate the host again with S1, S2 or S3.
